question: What is the role of the supreme Shakti above the Shiva principle?
premises: Above the Shiva principle is the supreme Shakti.
She is established as the agent of all causes.
inference: Samanā, the supreme Shakti above the Shiva principle, functions as the active agent behind all causes.
plain_english: Above the Shiva principle stands the supreme Shakti, called Samanā. She is established as the agent who acts through all causes.
